verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping API, so an undetected or stealth browser mode for bypassing bot detection is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents rendering, browser actions (click, wait, scroll) and screenshots, but nothing about stealth, fingerprint evasion or anti-bot bypass. Community comments only ask whether residential proxies are used, which is not evidence that the capability exists.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an undetected browser mode to bypass sophisticated bot detection systems
